metadata.description: Security testing skills for web applications, APIs, AI/LLM systems and mobile — built for red team and security engineers

plugins.name: web-recon
plugins.description: Full web application reconnaissance: technology fingerprinting, endpoint discovery, JS bundle analysis, subdomain enumeration and attack surface mapping

plugins.name: api-security-audit
plugins.description: API security testing: authentication bypass, broken access control, CORS misconfig, rate limiting, exposed docs, IDOR, and sensitive data exposure

plugins.name: ai-llm-security
plugins.description: AI/LLM-specific security testing based on OWASP LLM Top 10: prompt injection, jailbreak, SSRF via tools, architecture exposure, model DoS and data poisoning

plugins.name: firebase-security
plugins.description: Firebase-specific security audit: exposed API keys, Security Rules misconfig, user enumeration, authentication bypass and storage access control

plugins.name: broken-auth-testing
plugins.description: Authentication and session management testing: token validation, session fixation, cookie security, credential stuffing, brute force and MFA bypass

plugins.name: injection-testing
plugins.description: Injection vulnerability testing: SQL, NoSQL, XSS (reflected/stored/DOM), command injection, SSTI and LDAP injection with payloads and remediation

plugins.name: pentest-report
plugins.description: Generate structured penetration test reports in Markdown with CVSS scoring, proof-of-concept evidence, risk classification and remediation roadmap

plugins.name: owasp-top10
plugins.description: Full OWASP Top 10 (2021) assessment workflow with checklists, test cases and evidence collection for each of the 10 risk categories
